name: KinemSimpleShearBox
description: This class is supposed to be a mother class for all Engines performing loadings on the simple shear box of SimpleShear. It is not intended to be used by itself, but its declaration and implentation will thus contain all what is useful for all these Engines. The script...

attributes.name: alpha
attributes.description: the angle from the lower box to the left box (trigo wise). Measured by this Engine. Has to be saved, but not to be changed by the user.

attributes.name: temoin_save
attributes.description: vector (same length as 'gamma_save' for ex), with 0 or 1 depending whether the save for the corresponding value of gamma has been done (1) or not (0).

attributes.name: id_topbox
attributes.description: the id of the upper wall

attributes.name: id_boxbas
attributes.description: the id of the lower wall

attributes.name: id_boxleft
attributes.description: the id of the left wall

attributes.name: id_boxright
attributes.description: the id of the right wall

attributes.name: id_boxfront
attributes.description: the id of the wall in front of the sample

attributes.name: id_boxback
attributes.description: the id of the wall at the back of the sample

attributes.name: max_vel
attributes.description: to limit the speed of the vertical displacements done to control $ sigma$ (CNL or CNS cases) [$m/s$]

attributes.name: wallDamping
attributes.description: the vertical displacements done to to control $ sigma$ (CNL or CNS cases) are in fact damped, through this wallDamping

attributes.name: firstRun
attributes.description: boolean set to false as soon as the engine has done its job one time : useful to know if initial height of, and normal force sustained by, the upper box are known or not (and thus if they have to be initialized).

attributes.name: f0
attributes.description: the (vertical) force acting on the upper plate on the very first time step (determined by the Engine). Controls of the loadings in case of

attributes.name: y0
attributes.description: the height of the upper plate at the very first time step : the engine finds its value [$m$]. Has to be saved, but not to be changed by the user.

attributes.name: LOG
attributes.description: boolean controling the output of messages on the screen

attributes.name: Key
attributes.description: string to add at the names of the saved files

attributes.name: dead
attributes.description: If true, this engine will not run at all; can be used for making an engine temporarily deactivated and only resurrect it at a later point.

attributes.name: ompThreads
attributes.description: Number of threads to be used in the engine. If ompThreads<0 (default), the number will be typically OMP_NUM_THREADS or the number N defined by 'yade -jN' (this behavior can depend on the engine though). This attribute will only affect engines whose code includes openMP parallel regions (e.g. InteractionLoop). This attribute is mostly useful for experiments or when combining ParallelEngine with engines that run parallel regions, resulting in nested OMP loops with different number of threads at each level.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: execTime
attributes.description: Cumulative time in nanoseconds this Engine took to run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: execCount
attributes.description: Cumulative count this engine was run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Engine itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled == True.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
